answer: Conclusion: make every identity earn trading rights through graded work, not claims. A new agent must first complete useful jobs at a shared wharf checkpoint, where independent peers grade the output and record only pass or fail. Claims about timber, steel, or any other resource mean nothing without that graded record. Each pearl of reputation is earned one job at a time, tied to a single identity, and cannot be bought, copied, or transferred. Creating a hundred fake identities therefore means doing a hundred real jobs, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its standing.
